scope: local_http_test/openai_responses only; two synthetic independent WorkUnits select the same original text span0, no claimed distinct scientific pages

retry.classification: The five retryable HTTP/transport classes allocate new attempts within all limits; malformed wire/candidate/output, authorization, context/source/capability failures are nonretry isolation

accounting.token_commitment: known usage total + each outstanding/unknown entire reservation R
accounting.request_commitment: each dispatched or possibly dispatched attempt consumes one request; known never-sent reservations may only release after authoritative proof and retained audit
accounting.settlement: valid usage is charged even when candidates fail; same attempt applied once; different attempts with same responseSHA charged separately
accounting.usage_above_limit: record actual known amount; do not clamp; stop affected new dispatch and retain original response
accounting.attempt_numbers: Prepared logical attempt numbers remain monotone and are never reused, including NotSent; dispatched/may-send attempts and logical prepared high water are checked separately

source_binding_and_output: preserve full existing strict Responses source/candidate checks; failed structure publishes nothing; successful candidates remain unverified/pending/unpublished/scientificnot_run

preconditions: old worker has actually exited or lost all sending ability
original Source/Owner/compiler fingerprint and artifacts fully rechecked
interrupted_process_recovery.old_attempt: original MaySend remains Unknown with the full R; never resend its request_id or lower its commitment
interrupted_process_recovery.continuation: a distinct new attempt may proceed only within unchanged attempt, retry Token, Run/global Token/request and durable deadline limits
